EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Trial Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define a structured schema for trial relevance including condition match strength, eligibility alignment, normalized tokens, and overall relevance score. Extend clinical_trials_models to include explainability fields (matched_terms, exclusion_flags).

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Build core matching engine comparing user intent to trial conditions and eligibility criteria. Include normalization, synonym handling, partial matching, and weighted scoring across condition and eligibility dimensions.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Expose Relevance Signals via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade responses to include relevance score, matched condition terms, and eligibility signals. Ensure compatibility with tool_router and existing response structure.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Unit Tests for Relevance Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Create unit tests covering exact condition matches, partial matches, synonym expansion, eligibility inclusion/exclusion conflicts, and score consistency across repeated runs.
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials relevance tests found; must create new test module under backend/tests/

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Integrate and Rank Trials by Relevance in Pipeline
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Integrate relevance scoring into clinical_trials_service so trials are scored and ranked before returning. Preserve existing filters (e.g., recruiting status) and ensure stable ordering.
